author: Garsooon
name: GithubFeed
short: Post GitHub releases, commits and pull requests to a Discord channel.
description: Polls the GitHub REST API and publishes new releases, commits and pull request activity as embeds. Supports private repos through a GitHub token set by the bot owner with [p]ghfeed token (entered by DM).
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores only repository names, channel IDs and polling markers. It stores no personal user data.
install_msg: Thanks for installing GithubFeed! Use `[p]ghfeed add owner/repo` to start. For private repos or higher rate limits the bot owner runs `[p]ghfeed token` and replies in DM.
